ios.desc:
Plan smarter runs, review every workout, and keep improving over time.
Sync training from your watch, track progress clearly, and turn every run into useful insight.
From your first 5K to your next marathon, PaceGuru helps you train with more structure and confidence.

Key Features:

Watch Sync:
Instantly import and analyze your running data.

Advanced Run Tracking: 
Monitor weekly, monthly, and 30-day progress with detailed stats and intuitive charts.

Performance Insights: 
Visualize distance, pace, heart rate, and calories burned to spot trends and areas for improvement.

Personalized Training Plans: 
Create custom heart rate and pace zones. Design and sync tailored running plans directly to your watch.

Plan, Run, Review: 
Set your goals, track every run, and review your progress to keep improving.

Whether you’re training for your first 5K or chasing a marathon PR, Pace Guru gives you the insights and tools to run smarter, stronger, and further.

Download Pace Guru and unlock your full running potential today!
